observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale on a checkerboard. South: a deep-bodied silver-blue fish seen head-on. Two dark eyes sit on either side of a downturned mouth, the dorsal fin points straight up, pectoral and pelvic fins spread to the sides, and a short line of glowing cyan dots shows on each flank edge. East: a full side profile of the same fish with a forked blue tail, a dorsal fin, a large dark eye, and a single straight row of glowing cyan dots running along the mid-flank. North: the fish seen from behind. The dorsal fin points up, the forked tail fin is seen edge-on as a vertical blade running down the middle, pectorals spread to the sides, and a curved line of cyan dots shows on each flank. There is no eye or mouth. All three are the same height; the end-on views are narrower, as expected.
observed.south.png: A head-on fish face: two dark eyes, a small downturned mouth, a silvery-blue scaled head and body, the dorsal fin rising above, paired fins splayed, and cyan dots on both flanks. Painterly shading with a thin dark outline. Clean transparent background.
observed.east.png: The installed side-profile fish: silver-blue scales, light-blue fins, a forked tail, a large dark eye, a slight frown, and a row of about 10 glowing cyan dots along the flank. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: A rear, end-on view: a rounded scaled body with the dorsal fin up top and the tail fin edge-on as a long vertical blade down the centre, extending below the body. Pectoral and pelvic fins at the sides, and curved rows of cyan dots on both flanks. No face. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the fish is about one cell long, roughly the width of the human's torso, which suits a food fish. At 32 px/cell it reads as a small blue fish shape beside the human and rat.
